title: Powerful Compute So Compact, It’s Clutch — Build AI Anywhere With NVIDIA Jetson
excerpt: The NVIDIA Jetson platform for edge AI and robotics gives busy developers both power and portability in one agentic-ready AI platform.
content_html:
As a discerning AI investor who values style and substance, Sarah Guo knows this season’s standout accessory isn’t the latest designer purse — but what’s inside it. 

In a recent video, Guo, founder of AI-native venture capital firm Conviction and co-host of the AI podcast No Priors, highlighted how the NVIDIA Jetson platform for edge AI and robotics gives busy developers both power and portability in one agentic-ready AI platform built for the physical world — and every industry. The best part? It all fits in one handbag.

Compact enough to carry in a bag, yet powerful enough to take on the toughest problems, NVIDIA Jetson modules and developer kits power robots, autonomous machines and real-world AI projects in classrooms, labs and makerspaces — wherever inspiration strikes — enabling developers to build using industry-transforming frontier open models at the highest standard of safety and security.

Whether for a student running their first robotics project on Jetson Orin Nano Super, a professor bringing cutting-edge AI to their curriculum on Jetson AGX Orin or a researcher pushing the limits of autonomous systems with Jetson AGX Thor, the platform enables building, learning and launching the next generation of intelligent robots — in every classroom, every lab and every country. 

As Guo shows: bring the bag, Jetson brings the robot brain. 

Check back here throughout the week for a series of examples — beginning with the Jetson Orin Nano Super below — to help developers navigate the NVIDIA Jetson platform and get started on their next robotics breakthroughs.

NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super: Ideal for Building a First AI Robot

Robots deserve a real brain and, apparently, an incredibly chic commute. When Guo popped the Jetson Orin Nano Super into her Jacquemus Mini, she gained the entire AI stack right at her fingertips — now with a cute handle: clutch!

Jetson Orin Nano Super brings desktop-class generative AI to a handbag-friendly developer kit, offering first-time builders a practical path to learning computer vision, building AI agents, prototyping edge AI and more. With 67 trillion operations per second (TOPS) of AI performance, Jetson Orin Nano Super helps developers get started on the problems they’ve always wanted to solve.

To help builders move from inspiration to implementation, NVIDIA Jetson Device Skills and Jetson BSP Skills give students, researchers and developers an easier way to harness coding AI agents to create, optimize and deploy real-world AI at the edge.

Robot builders can get inspired to start their first — or next — dream project with these innovative examples of Jetson Orin Nano Super in action:

Self Driving My EV Car  | Model SidewalkPilot

A custom SidewalkPilot AI model autonomously executes maneuvers in a toy electric vehicle using Jetson Orin Nano Super.

Reachy Mini Jetson Assistant

Reachy Mini Jetson Assistant is a low-latency, fully on-device voice and vision assistant for Reachy Mini Lite powered by NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super. Everything runs locally with GPU acceleration — no cloud, no API keys, no internet required at runtime. Get started here.

Building My First AI Robot From Scratch

Coding with Lewis constructed an AI-powered robot using Mistral — an open-weight model — showing that first time robotics developers can build from the ground up using Jetson Orin Nano Super.

Robotics AI Podcast

Using Jetson Orin Nano Super, Asier Arnaz built a Yocto-powered Robotics AI video podcast featuring two AI models discussing topics in real-time and highlighting what makers are creating at the edge.

Inspired yet? Get started by joining our livestream series. Across three modules, developers can learn to run generative AI, build claw agents and bring vision-language and vision-language-action models to power real-world physical AI applications — all on NVIDIA Jetson.

Bring Powerful AI to Real-World Machines With Jetson AGX Orin

With 275 TOPS of AI performance, Jetson AGX Orin is there when workloads get more complex. For Guo, it’s simple: more TOPS, more tote.

For more advanced makers, Jetson AGX Orin brings the full power of AI into coursework, capstone projects and applied research, powering advanced robots, autonomous machines and AI at the edge — and proving serious AI no longer has to live in a server room, or be reserved for those who can afford one. 

Jetson AGX Orin lets builders test real ideas in real environments, then carry the whole thing to class, the lab, the demo table or that first investor meeting. 

With versatility for advanced robotics curriculum and serious startup projects, Jetson AGX Orin can support computer vision, generative AI, autonomous navigation and more, making it ideal for transforming virtually every industry, whether creating delivery bots, smart vision capabilities or industrial automation. 

Go next-level with these innovative examples of Jetson AGX Orin in action:

Live VLM WebUI

A browser-based interface streams live vision language model inference on Jetson AGX Orin, letting users interact with a VLM in real time through their camera feed.

SMoRes

A Carnegie Mellon University robotics team’s autonomous system builds a 3D map of an environment while simultaneously searching for survivors in time-critical rescue scenarios.

Tomorrow, build bigger than ‘back to school’ with Jetson AGX Thor.

content_html_zh:
作为一位重视风格和实质、眼光独到的人工智能投资者，SarahGuo 知道本季最引人注目的配饰不是最新款的设计师钱包，而是里面的东西。

在最近的一段视频中，AI 原生风险投资公司 Conviction 的创始人兼 AI 播客 No Priors 的联合主持人郭强调了用于边缘 AI 和机器人技术的 NVIDIA Jetson 平台如何为忙碌的开发人员在一个专为物理世界和每个行业构建的代理就绪 AI 平台中提供强大的功能和可移植性。 最好的部分？ 所有这些都可以装在一个手提包中。

https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SarahGuo_Jetson01_captions.mp4

NVIDIA Jetson 模块和开发套件结构紧凑，可放入包中携带，但功能强大，足以解决最棘手的问题，可为教室、实验室和创客空间中的机器人、自主机器和现实世界的 AI 项目（无论灵感何时出现）提供动力，使开发人员能够使用行业变革的前沿开放模型，以最高的安全标准进行构建。

无论是在 Jetson Orin Nano Super 上运行第一个机器人项目的学生、在 Jetson AGX Orin 上将尖端人工智能引入课程的教授，还是使用 Jetson AGX Thor 突破自主系统极限的研究人员，该平台都可以在每个教室、每个实验室和每个国家构建、学习和启动下一代智能机器人。

正如郭展示的那样：带上包，Jetson 带来机器人大脑。

本周请回来查看一系列示例（从下面的 Jetson Orin Nano Super 开始），以帮助开发人员驾驭 NVIDIA Jetson 平台并开始实现下一个机器人突破。

NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super：构建第一个 AI 机器人的理想选择

机器人应该拥有真正的大脑，显然还应该拥有令人难以置信的别致的通勤方式。 当郭将 Jetson Orin Nano Super 放入她的 Jacquemus Mini 中时，她触手可及地获得了整个 AI 堆栈 - 现在有了一个可爱的手柄：离合器！

Jetson Orin Nano Super 将桌面级生成式 AI 引入到适合手提包的开发人员套件中，为首次构建者提供了学习计算机视觉、构建 AI 代理、制作边缘 AI 原型等的实用途径。 Jetson Orin Nano Super 拥有每秒 67 万亿次操作 (TOPS) 的 AI 性能，可帮助开发人员开始解决他们一直想解决的问题。 为了帮助构建者从灵感转向实施，NVIDIA Jetson 设备技能和 Jetson BSP 技能为学生、研究人员和开发人员提供了一种更简单的方法来利用编码 AI 代理在边缘创建、优化和部署现实世界的 AI。 机器人建造者可以通过 Jetson Orin Nano Super 的这些创新示例获得灵感，开始他们的第一个或下一个梦想项目：

自动驾驶我的电动汽车 |模型人行道飞行员

定制的 SidewalkPilot AI 模型使用 Jetson Orin Nano Super 在玩具电动车中自主执行操作。

Reachy Mini Jetson 助手

https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Reachy-Mini-Jetson-Assistant.mp4

Reachy Mini Jetson Assistant 是一款低延迟、完全设备端语音和视觉助手，适用于由 NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super 提供支持的 Reachy Mini Lite。 一切都通过 GPU 加速在本地运行 - 运行时无需云、API 密钥、无需互联网。 从这里开始。

从头开始构建我的第一个人工智能机器人

Coding with Lewis 使用 Mistral（一种开放重量模型）构建了一个人工智能驱动的机器人，这表明机器人开发人员可以使用 Jetson Orin Nano Super 从头开始​​构建。

机器人人工智能播客

https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/JONS_robotic-ai-podcast.mp4

Asier Arnaz 使用 Jetson Orin Nano Super 构建了一个由 Yocto 驱动的机器人 AI 视频播客，其中两个 AI 模型实时讨论主题，并强调创客在边缘创造的内容。

受到启发了吗？ 从加入我们的直播系列开始吧。 通过三个模块，开发人员可以学习运行生成式 AI、构建爪形代理以及引入视觉语言和视觉语言动作模型来为现实世界的物理 AI 应用程序提供支持 — 所有这些都在 NVIDIA Jetson 上进行。

借助 Jetson AGX Orin 将强大的 AI 引入现实世界的机器

凭借 275 TOPS 的 AI 性能，Jetson AGX Orin 可以在工作负载变得更加复杂时发挥作用。 对于郭来说，这很简单：更多上衣，更多手提包。

https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/SarahGuo_Jetson02_captions.mp4

对于更先进的创客来说，Jetson AGX Orin 将人工智能的全部力量带入课程作业、顶点项目和应用研究中，为先进机器人、自主机器和边缘人工智能提供动力，并证明真正的人工智能不再需要住在服务器机房中，也不再需要为那些负担得起的人保留。

Jetson AGX Orin 让构建者可以在真实环境中测试真实的想法，然后将整个想法带到课堂、实验室、演示台或第一次投资者会议上。

Jetson AGX Orin 具有适用于高级机器人课程和严肃的创业项目的多功能性，可以支持计算机视觉、生成式 AI、自主导航等，使其成为几乎每个行业转型的理想选择，无论是创建交付机器人、智能视觉功能还是工业自动化。

通过 Jetson AGX Orin 的这些创新示例，迈上新的台阶：

实时 VLM WebUI

https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/LVW_install_walkthrough_1Mbps.mp4

基于浏览器的界面在 Jetson AGX Orin 上传输实时视觉语言模型推理，让用户通过摄像头与 VLM 实时交互。

SMoRes

卡内基梅隆大学机器人团队的自主系统构建了环境的 3D 地图，同时在时间紧迫的救援场景中搜索幸存者。

明天，与 Jetson AGX Thor 一起建造比“重返校园”更大的建筑。
